profile.title: Excel & CSV Data Cleaning Specialist | Python Automation
profile.overview:
I help businesses transform messy, unorganized spreadsheets into clean, actionable data — fast.

With 5+ years of experience in data processing, Python automation, and Excel/Google Sheets, I specialize in taking the headache out of data cleanup so you can focus on what matters.

**What I do:**
- Clean messy CSV/Excel files (duplicates, inconsistent formatting, missing values)
- Standardize dates, phone numbers, addresses across thousands of rows
- Merge multiple spreadsheets and remove duplicate records
- Build automation scripts so you can repeat the process yourself
- Convert PDFs, text files, and unstructured data into organized spreadsheets

**Why work with me:**
- ⚡ Fast turnaround: Most projects delivered within 24 hours
- ✅ Quality guaranteed: Unlimited revisions until you're satisfied
- 🔒 Secure: Your data is handled confidentially and never shared
- 💬 Clear communication: You'll always know the status of your project

**Tools I use:** Python (pandas, openpyxl), Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Power Query

Let me know what you're working with — I'll give you a clear quote and timeline within hours.
